actors.name: Marlin Bay dockworkers' union local
actors.private_context: The local's executive board met twice last week without issuing a statement. The local is aware of the port automation memorandum and is considering whether to endorse it. There is internal disagreement: a rank-and-file caucus has been leafleting against the memorandum. The international union endorsed a similar deal at another port last month, which may influence but does not bind the local.

shared_context: The port automation memorandum exists and is a matter of public record. The local can issue a press release through standard channels. The deadline for a decision is before Monday, 2026-08-31.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. No press release has been issued yet by the local.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the local actually issued a press release before 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00 stating its endorsement or non-endorsement of the port automation memorandum. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
